articleTitle: FreeRTOS software system based on Chinese Micro-Control Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet of Things, China’s integrated chip industry has made great progress. A large number of micro-control unit (MCU) enterprises have emerged in China. GigaDevice Semiconductor Inc. develops particularly rapidly. In this paper, GigaDevice’s GD32F450 is used to build a Free Real Time Operating System (FreeRTOS) software system. RTOS can make the programming of embedded systems simpler, more flexible and more efficient. In addition, in case the application partition is destroyed in the process of running, mirror application partitions A and B are used in this system. The bootloader decides to load A or B, and repairs broken partitions automatically if needed. The Two-Level Segregated Fit (TLSF) algorithm is used to optimize the memory management.

articleTitle: A blockchain and multi factor fusion based electronic identity registration and verification system
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: This work proposed a decentralized and multi factor fusion approach to electronic identity registration and verification, and uses blockchain technology to complete the design of the system. The system includes client, identity registration system, identity verification system, electronic signature system and blockchain service module, so as to complete the registration and verification service. The registration system can read citizen’s identity from the ID card by OCR or NFC, processed by electronic signature system, generate a QR code which contain the encrypted electronic identity. The consortium blockchain and decentralized identity storage system are used to store the encrypted identity information. The verification system use identity information plus biometric multi-factor fusion identity verification mode to create a unique ID and using location sensitive hash algorithm to process biometric features can identify a citizen. The system is efficient and trustworthy, with higher security than the previous centralized authentication scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Sales Forecast of Automobile Spare Parts Based on LightGBM and Feature Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: There are many factors affecting the sales of automobile spare parts, which are difficult to mine and the prediction accuracy is low. In order to improve the prediction ability of auto enterprises on spare parts sales, this paper proposes an automobile spare parts sales prediction algorithm based on LightGBM and feature engineering. Firstly, the data are preprocessed and feature are extracted, analyzed and selected. The data are predicted by LightGBM algorithm, and the prediction performance is compared and analyzed. Experiments show that the use of feature engineering in predicting the sales of automobile spare parts can obtain better prediction performance, which qualification rate can be improved by about 3%.

articleTitle: An Artificial Hummingbird Optimization Algorithm Incorporating Adaptive Search and Levy Flight
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: To address the problems of low accuracy of artificial hummingbird algorithm (AHA) and its tendency to fall into local optimum, we propose a new artificial hummingbird optimization algorithm (ALAHA) integrating adaptive search and Levy flight. First, we use kent mapping in the initial stage of the algorithm to make the distribution of hummingbird individuals more uniform; then, we introduce Levy flight as an adaptive weight factor to adjust the search step size in the AHA guided foraging and territorial foraging stages to improve the global search ability of the population; finally, we perform adaptive distance search around hummingbird individuals according to the population convergence to improve the search accuracy of the algorithm. In this paper, 10 classical benchmark test functions are selected to experiment the algorithm and compared with other algorithms to test the performance of the algorithm from different perspectives. The results show that the improvement of ALAHA algorithm has improved in the aspects of merit-seeking ability, stability and robustness. The algorithm before and after the improvement is also experimented with the rolling bearing design, and the results are found to be improved compared with the previous algorithm.

articleTitle: Using Function Call Sequence for Browser Fingerprinting Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Browser fingerprinting is a stateless tracking technique that combines browser attributes into a single identifier for tracking users. As browser fingerprinting is used by a growing number of websites, many works have focused on browser fingerprinting detection. Existing works mostly consider detection through the perspective of script, it will case false negative when script is split. In this paper, we propose BFDetector, an approach for better detecting browser fingerprinting, to solve the problem of script splitting. To this end, BFDetector uses function call sequence of web pages to detect browser fingerprinting through NLP-based one-class deep learning ensemble. We collected 7,800 function call sequences as dataset from Alexa top-10K websites’ homepage. After collecting these function call sequences, we trained a Javascript API embedding to convert each function to a vector for training deep leaning classifier. Through the test of our own dataset, the accuracy of classifier has reached 95.53%. Afterward, we analysed the characteristic of some known fingerprinting techniques’ function call sequence and found a newly fingerprinting technique that we call it media-based fingerprinting.

articleTitle: Customer churn Research Based on LightGBM
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: After more than ten years of rapid development, the bank credit card market is now very competitive. Many banks blindly pursue the increase in credit card issuance, ignoring the maintenance of existing customers, resulting in an increasing number of "dormant cards" and frequent customer loss, which is likely to become a hidden danger for the stable development of the banking industry. It is particularly important to Change the business philosophy of the banking industry and improve the loyalty of credit card customers for the development of the banking industry. Therefore, it is very important to establish a model based on LightGBM to predict the loss of credit card customers, and identify customers with churn tendencies in time, so as to better maintain customer resources. Through experimental analysis, it is found that the LightGBM model has the highest accuracy, reaching 95%. This also provides help for bank managers in customer churn prediction and customer retention, which has certain research significance.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Sound Diagnosis Model for Transformer Discharge Fault Based on Knowledge Distillation with Supercomputing
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Transformer discharge is a serious power system fault, which can lead to catastrophic accidents. Intelligent analysis of discharge faults by collecting transformer sound provides a non-invasive and sustainable health monitoring method. This paper proposes a lightweight voice fault diagnosis model based on knowledge distillation. The method utilizes the computing power of the supercomputing platform to train multiple teacher models in parallel, and then distill the knowledge of the teacher model into a lightweight student model, which not only achieves good classification accuracy but also can be easily deployed to edge computing platform. The experimental results show that the accuracy of our method is 95.65%, with only 1.28M parameters and only 0.35GFlops calculation amount, which proves the superiority of the method.

articleTitle: Study on the Applicability of Cross-border E-commerce Platform System Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Cross-border e-commerce platforms are the core of the development of cross-border e-commerce industry, and the differences in platform system functions cause export enterprises to incur high selection costs. This paper analyzes the applicability of Amazon and Wish cross-border e-commerce platform system functions to Shaanxi cross-border e-commerce enterprises, adopts AHP-fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method in the analysis method, and calculates the weight of evaluation indicators, platform fuzzy evaluation matrix and overall membership of cross-border e-commerce platform system operation through Matlab instructions, and concludes that the Wish platform system functions are more suitable for Shaanxi cross-border e-commerce export enterprises.

articleTitle: Personalized Federated Learning with Data Heterogeneity Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Federated learning, a new distributed, edge-device based machine learning paradigm that does not require the collection of raw data from the client and has a significant privacy protection effect. However, since the data distribution of each client is Noniid, it will lead to the degradation of the model performance. We propose a new personalization federated learning approach to alleviate this problem that uses base layer and personalization layer, In addition, we add a restriction that we use the degree of Noniid (DoN) to constrain the personalization layer training. The larger the DoN, the more we allow the local model personalization layer to deviate from the global model personalization layer. Further, we have experimentally demonstrated that our method is superior to the federated averaging algorithm.

articleTitle: Text classification of electricity policy information based on BERT-optimized TextRNN
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In order to improve the effective query of power policy information, we design and implement text classification of power policy information. Aiming at the problem of sparse news headline features and strong context dependence in power policy news text classification, a semantic enhancement-based power policy news text classification method is studied. In this paper, based on the traditional TextRNN, we use the BERT language model instead of the traditional Word2Vec model for semantic representation; at the same time, for the LSTM network used by the traditional TextRNN, the Bi-LSTM network is used to extract feature vectors, and then connect the Attention layer to get fusion. The feature vector is finally input into Softmax to get the model classification result. The final experimental results show that the TextRNN network optimized based on BERT has a better classification effect.

articleTitle: A Multi-classification Model of Industry Based on Multi-task Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the development of economy, Chinese enterprises are developing rapidly and diversifying. It is of practical significance to study the problem of multi-label classification of industry. In this paper, we propose a multi-task industry multi-classification model, MABA (Multi-task learning based on ALBERT pre-training, Bi-GRU, Attention), which uses a multi-task learning method that jointly trains industry classification tasks and industry chain classification tasks to assist in industry classification. The model was experimented on more than 790,000 data, and multi-task learning was experimentally compared with single-task learning. The results showed that multi-task learning has improved in precision, recall, and f1-score than single-task learning, which proves the effectiveness of multi-task learning.

articleTitle: Novel Cattle Farm Management System Based on IoT and RFID
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The existing cattle farm management software cannot meet the requirements of large-scale cattle farms. This study aimed to develop a practical tool for cattle farmers and to aid farmers in feeding more cows. The novel cattle farm management system (NCFMS) was developed using the JAVA programming language in the Android Studio Development Environment. The NCFMS system consisted of eight functional modules: herd, breeding, reproduction, lactation, fattening, health, reporting, and user management. This system was installed in smartphones with UHF RFID and has been used on dairy and beef farms in Henan Province since 2018. The results showed that the NCFMS system could rapidly record the details of cattle growth and then generate farm reports on cattle breeding and production utilizing the collected data. The cattle farms using this system can significantly increase work efficiency by 30%. In conclusion, this system will be a practical tool to assist the farmer in decision-making for cattle farms.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Dynamic Interactive E-Book System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Under the background of flourishing computer technology, books gradually become electronic. Electronic books bring great convenience to people’s learning, but at present their advantages are more reflected in the digitization of content than in the computability and interactivity. In order to further explore the value of electronic books, this paper studies the design and implementation of a dynamic interactive e-book system. This system can present knowledge in a dynamic way, and has obvious practical significance in promoting learners’ deep understanding of knowledge. This paper first introduces the relationship between the modules in the system, then takes the geometry subsystem as an example to discuss its architecture and technical implementation methods, and finally gives the demonstration of this subsystem.

articleTitle: Personalized Course Recommendation Model Based on User’s Interests and Feature Information
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: To resolve the problems of sparse data and poor recommendation effect in course recommendation, a personalized course recommendation model based on user’s interests and feature information is presented in this study. Firstly, the weight of feature information of the course is defined to reflect the importance of the attributes of the course in the recommendation process. Secondly, the exponential decay function is designed and the time coefficient is integrated to fully adapt to the changes of user interests over time. Finally, the collaborative filtering recommendation scheme is introduced to integrate user interest preferences and attributes to obtain a comprehensive similarity. The experimental results show that the experimental results on the dataset show that the proposed collaborative filtering recommendation model can provide better recommendation quality than traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on the Virtual Currency Payment System Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: As a focus in the field of financial innovation, blockchain technology is essentially a distributed ledger database, and it is open and transparent, decentralized and immutable in practical application. In the steady development of financial technology, blockchain technology, as a basic content, has attracted the attention of researchers and scholars, and from this, the payment system of virtual currency has been constructed. This greatly facilitates people’s daily life. Therefore, based on the understanding of the definition of blockchain technology and the influence of the content of this technology on the payment system, this paper deeply discusses the convenient payment system and its operation mode with blockchain technology as the core, and finally conducts verification analysis under the new cross-border payment mode. The results show that the virtual currency payment system based on blockchain technology is feasible and effective in practice. Especially in the social economy with the acceleration of network technological innovation, increasingly frequent international exchanges and constantly improved trade modes, the application of block chain technology contribute to the economic development of our country and gradually integrate into the international market, but from the point of view of the whole system security and technical performance, there are still many problems.

articleTitle: Key Technology and Realization Route of Structured emergency plan
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Structured emergency plan is crucial to achieving the digital emergency plan. Based on the demand analysis of the structured emergency plan, this paper proposes the system architecture and core functional framework of the structured application of emergency plan. Based on the closed-loop management of the application of emergency plan, this paper studies the key technologies and implementation paths of the application of structured emergency plan from three important stages, namely the generation, implementation and optimization of emergency plan. It can effectively promote the structural construction, digital upgrade and transformation of emergency plan, and promote the efficient operation of emergency plan. From the perspective of application and implementation, the key technologies and implementation paths of the emergency plan structure are functional and practical, the tools are convenient and operable, the emergency measures are specific and the emergency plan is targeted, and the overall effectiveness is high.

articleTitle: A Study on the Scale Development of User Perceived Life Experience in the Human-Computer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Users’ life experience in human-computer interaction (HCI) is becoming increasingly important. However, there is no research on the operational concept and measurement instrument of perceived life experience in HCI. Based on the Big Five personality and Confucian culture, this study aims to construct and verify the users’ perceived life experience in HCI for the first time in metaverse education. The study conducted 573 respondents to an analysis by exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analysis in China following scientific and rigorous scale development steps. The results show five dimensions of perceived life experience, including perceived sincerity, perceived responsibility, perceived upbringing, perceived wisdom, and perceived reliability, a total of 23 items. This scale has passed the reliability and validity tests, which provide an empirical basis for future research on the perceived life experience of HCI.

articleTitle: Design of Human Resource Management System Based on Java EE
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the maturity of the network, the competition among enterprises has shifted from the tangible economic market to the network. In order to effectively improve the office efficiency of enterprises, a human resource management system is designed and implemented. The traditional manual management mode has low management efficiency, delayed data update and is easily influenced by external factors. In order to improve the efficiency, informatization level and competitiveness of enterprise human resource management, it is extremely necessary for modern enterprises to develop human resource management system. Based on Java EE, a human resource management system with simple interface, easy operation and friendly human-computer interaction is designed and developed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Character Edge Detection and Recognition Algorithm Based on Optical Flow Calculation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: At present, the mainstream of the operation and maintenance of the power grid information system is to log in to the LAN through the bastion machine, and remotely operate the bastion machine for information maintenance and operation. This paper proposes a real-time text recognition algorithm based on video stream, which establishes user permissions such as characters and bytes, and regularizes instructions. The rule base can monitor each character or byte to quickly locate abnormal operations, and give warning operation risk prompts for abnormal instructions. It monitors the input of terminal commands. When a specific command is prohibited, it will prompt or reject the operation in time to achieve remote control of the information system. Through the unified monitoring of the command input of the operation and maintenance terminal, the risk control of the remote operation and maintenance of the information system is strengthened, and the controllability of the remote operation and maintenance of the information system is improved.

articleTitle: Study on MRI Brain Tumor Segmentation Based on Improved Transfuse Network Model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Using the computer to segment MRI brain tumor images automatically has become one of the current research hotspots. Due to the complex characteristics of MRI images, it is challenging to separate normal and pathological tissues accurately, so efficient feature extraction methods are critical. Among many medical image segmentation methods, the U-Net network has achieved great success. However, because of the limitations of convolution, it cannot learn a global and long sequence of semantic information well. The Transformer has an excellent global self-attention mechanism to learn long sequences of semantic information and has developed into an excellent alternative framework in recent years, but its low-level detail processing ability is limited. We adopted a new parallel branch structure to improve the global context information of the image and better deal with the low-level details. In this paper, we combined the global image information processed by the Transformer with the detail features processed by the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). In the fusion module, we adopted spatial attention mechanism and ECA-Net channel attention mechanism. ECA-Net accelerated information exchange between channels. Many experiments have proved that the improved Transfuse method has significant performance. The mean Dice and IoU of our model are 95.51% and 93.32% in the MRI brain tumor segmentation task.

articleTitle: a Two-stage Strategy for Skin Cancer Classification Based on Dermoscopic Images
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Data imbalance in skin lesions datasets are common problems of skin cancer classification tasks based on deep learning. This study proposes a two-stage classification strategy based on an advanced benchmark multi-classification model, which transforms the "multi-category" task into a "main class and non-main class binary" task and a "multi-category within non-main classes" task to smooth the class distribution of skin cancer datasets. This strategy can significantly improve the final classification performance compared to the direct multi-classification task, and can provide a reference for solving similar data imbalance problems.

articleTitle: Multi-center Federated Learning with Model Decoupling
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Federated learning enables multi-participants to collaboratively train a single model to solve the problem of data silos. But federated learning faces the problem of data heterogeneity. In this paper, we propose a simple and efficient personalized federated learning framework named FedMDC to solve the data heterogeneity problem. Adhering to the idea of seeking common ground while reserving differences, we effectively combine the idea of clustering and model decoupling, and provide each participant with a personalized model suitable for their own local data distribution. Our extensive experiments show that FedMDC significantly outperforms the other advanced federated learning algorithms on various image classification tasks.

articleTitle: Research on a Simulation Algorithm for Artillery Firepower Assignment According to Region
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: This paper proposes a simulation algorithm for fire distribution by area to ground attack. Taking battalion as an example, the algorithm for battalion level fire distribution by area includes shooting mode calculation model, impact point calculation model, ammunition consumption calculation model and damage probability calculation model. Based on this algorithm, the software is implemented and applied to related projects. Combined with the actual project, good results have been achieved.

Author Keywords: firepower assignment at the battalion level

articleTitle: Application of computer-based support vector machine technology in power customer credit rating
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the rapid development of the times, the field of computer technology is becoming wider and wider. In view of the research status of customer risk management in electric power enterprises, this paper establishes a customer risk assessment model based on computer support vector machine, and does some research work on the analysis and prediction of power customer credit. The experiment shows that the statistical learning method based on computer support vector machine can evaluate the credit of electric power customers, help electric power enterprises to select high-quality customers, and provide decision-making basis for electric power enterprises to actively prevent and avoid marketing risks.

articleTitle: InSAR Monitoring and Spatial-temporal Analysis of Surface Subsidence in Liaocheng
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In recent years, surface subsidence, ground fissures, surface collapse and other geological disasters occur frequently in cities. In order to prevent geological disasters, mitigate the losses caused by geological disasters, and safeguard the safety of people’s lives and property, the ground subsidence in Dongchangfu District of Liaocheng from November 2019 to March 2022 was monitored based on SBAS-InSAR technology, and the causes of land surface subsidence were analyzed in combination with the environmental conditions of key subsidence areas. The results indicated that, the subsidence in the southeast is overall, the subsidence in the northwest is uneven and the funnel is obvious, the northeast and southwest regions are relatively stable. The occurrence of urban surface subsidence is easily affected by groundwater exploitation and engineering activities.

articleTitle: An Access Control Scheme Based on Decentralized Identifiers and Verifiable Credentials in IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the Internet of Things (IoT) has become more complex, and more and more devices and users are connected to the IoT system. While improving data interactivity and expanding the scope of data sharing, secure access to IoT resources is also facing great risks. Therefore, it is necessary to design an appropriate access control scheme. Firstly, this paper introduces Decentralized Identifiers (DID) and Verifiable Credentials. It is used for authentication and rights management of users and devices, respectively, which makes identity and authority unforgeable. Secondly, this paper uses blockchain technology to support DID and Verifiable Credentials, which can ensure the decentralization, invariance and traceability of data. Finally, using smart contracts enables automatic processing of requester authorization and access requests. The test results show that the scheme has good performance.

articleTitle: Research on digital detection method based on edge point extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the rapid progress of industrial level, the inspection of product manufacturing deviation by scanning point cloud has become one of the key steps of quality inspection automation. In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of machining quality detection, this paper proposes a grid division method based on normal line. After point cloud model segmentation, noise reduction and downsampled , the secondary optimization of threshold parameters, combined with the radius outlier elimination method, a more complete and accurate edge point extraction is realized. Finally, taking the diesel engine runner shell as the study object, the error rate of the machining size of the key parts is calculated by using the edge point parameters. The results show that this method can avoid the edge point extraction error caused by improper threshold, effectively reducing the error rate of key parts detection, improve the detection accuracy and speed of product manufacturing deviation, and provide reference for the digital detection of product processing accuracy.

articleTitle: Federated Learning Optimization for Balancing Communication Cost and Model Accuracy under Data Heterogeneity
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Federated learning is a new distributed machine learning paradigm. A key and common challenge is the heterogeneity of data. Heterogeneous data across user devices can severely degrade the performance of federated learning, and different degrees of data heterogeneity also affect the performance of models. We find that increasing communication frequency can improve model prediction accuracy under heterogeneous data conditions. However, when a single communication is costly, we cannot simply increasing the communication frequency to obtain a better model. In this paper, we define a score function to determine how to select parameters at different degrees of data heterogeneity and with different preference for communication costs and model accuracy. Based on these, we propose a new method for model training by inferring the degree of data heterogeneity based on KL divergence of global model and local model, then choose the best parameters according to different degree of data heterogeneity and preference for communication cost and model accuracy, so as to achieve a good balance between communication cost and model accuracy.

articleTitle: A new double scrambling color image encryption algorithm based on multi chaotic systems and image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Aiming at low security of traditional encryption methods, this paper give a new encryption method by using multi chaotic systems and image segmentation. Firstly, use Arnold transform to perturb the RGB component matrices of the source image. Subsequently, the chaotic image chunking algorithm is applied to the mixed component matrix, and the chunked mixed matrix is perturbed by Hyperchaotic Chen system and Logistic mapping. Moreover, Diffusion of pixel transformations to the whole image by inverse transform operations. Finally, logistic system is applied to the secondary pixels scrambling, which achieves image encryption. The experimental data indicate that this encryption method encryption effect is good, and can effectively prevent ciphertext attack and noise attack.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Image Dehazing Application with Controllable Haze Density Based on Dark Channel
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In this paper, the application has been designed and developed for fuzzy removal of images using the OpenCV image processing library and the PyQt5 graphic framework, applying a dark channel image pre recovery algorithm, and this application can easily obtain dehazing images; The fuzzy elimination strength is controlled through the interface wheel and obtain haze concentration controllable dehaze image. It laid the foundation for further image processing, information acquisition and analysis.

articleTitle: Accident Analysis: A Text Mining and Complex Networks Framework for Safety Incident Prevention
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Safety is a key monitoring point for the construction project by engineers. Accidents in the project are often accompanied by casualties, property losses and lead to negative social impact. It is vital to learn from what is going wrong in previous safety accidents to prevent the reoccurrence of similar accidents in the future. Large quantities of accident investigation report texts provide a solid foundation for accident analysis. However, accident reports are typically documented and stored as unstructured or semi-structured text data, which makes analytical work difficult. This paper proposes an analytical framework to extract accident causes from accident narratives using text mining technology. An evaluation function TF-K* based on term frequency and complex networks is proposed to identify the importance of safety risk factors. The proposed framework is validated by analysing accident reports of housing and municipal construction in China for ten years.

articleTitle: Cloud-Edge-Device Integration Based On Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the arrival of the Internet of Everything era, the traditional network architecture is evolving in the cloud and the deep integration of IT technology and OT technology drives the development of industry intelligence, which leads to the development of edge computing. However, edge computing is faced with many problems, such as serious heterogeneity, large scale, complex environment, and inconsistent standards [1]. To solve these problems, cloud, edge and device integration architecture based on edge computing is developed. Starting from the shortcomings of cloud computing and the characteristics of edge computing, this paper first introduces the meaning of Cloud-Edge-Device integration. Secondly, introduces the three mainstream edge computing architectures, and analyzes their features. Then, this paper introduces a reasonable design framework for cloud-edge-device integration and puts forward the current innovation practice scenario of this integration model. Finally summarizes the development prospects and challenges of Cloud-Edge-Device integration.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of K-means Clustering Analysis Algorithm in the Information Warfare
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In the information warfare, information has become a new strategic commanding point. With the rapid change of the battlefield situation, the complexity of the battlefield environment and the diversification of combat elements, the analysis of massive data has become the key factor in determining the victory of the war. But, the traditional cluster analysis algorithm cannot obtain good results for these complex, multivariate and diversified war data. This paper study the clustering analysis technology deeply, aiming at the problem of K-means clustering algorithm, for example, sensitive to initial parameters, high time complexity, and difficult to find the optimal clustering results, improve the k-means clustering algorithm. By calculating and merging the high density regions, determine the k that is the initial parameter, obtain the local clustering results, then obtain the final clustering results by the global clustering and optimization processing, and prove the effectiveness and advancement of the algorithm by theoretical analysis and experimental results comparison.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of an Online Examination System Based on Maven Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Online examinations have been accepted by more and more people. However, the online examination system in China is still in the development stage. With the rapid development of computer software technology, we can apply a more perfect examination system to domestic universities and primary schools. The platform system is developed in Java language, using Maven container and MySQL database to achieve overall development. The front end is built by Bootstrap framework, and the back end is built by SSM framework. This paper focuses on the design and implementation of Maven based online examination system. The system is composed of students and administrators. This paper focuses on the design and implementation of Maven based online examination system. Students can learn and test independently through the system. As administrators, teachers can manage students’ learning process through the learning platform, so as to accurately master students’ learning progress. The system can intuitively realize the visualization of test questions, make the page more concise and clearer, improve the comfort of user interaction, and increase the user experience.

articleTitle: Service Decomposition method for multimodal data exchange scenarios
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Influenced by the complexity of multimodal data exchange scenarios and their differences in data flow graph construction, the objective basis of existing service decomposition methods is not sufficient, and the granularity of the results is too large and difficult to be decomposed. To address this problem, this paper presents a service decomposition method for multimodal data exchange scenarios. This method reconstructs the differentially constructed data flow diagram by unified rules at the stage of requirement analysis and design, and then completes the fine-grained division of microservices around documents based on service-decomposed rules. The case study shows that the method is more effective than the existing method in the multimodal data exchange scenario.

articleTitle: Architectural Distortion-Based Mammograms Classification Using Adaptive Contrast Enhancement and Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: A mammogram classification method based on adaptive contrast enhancement combined with residual network is proposed to address the problem that the image features of architectural distortion on mammography images are not obvious and easily overlap with breast glandular tissue and background structures. Firstly, the dataset samples are increased by data augmentation to avoid the overfitting problem caused by insufficient samples in deep learning. Secondly, the adaptive contrast enhancement algorithm is used to improve the image contrast and enhance the image defects. Finally, the residual network model is used for training, testing and validation. The experimental results show that the method has good classification effect, with accuracy and sensitivity reaching 0.8704 and 0.8782, respectively.

articleTitle: Identification of Microservices through Processed Dynamic Traces and Static Calls
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: As the complexity of software systems continues to increase, traditional monolithic software architectures will become difficult to scale and maintain. Microservices as an emerging software architecture it advocates decentralized management, service autonomy, and distinct module boundaries. These features of microservices make software systems easy to maintain, deploy, and modify. However, microservice identification is still not well addressed due to the lack of an effective approach. The existing work on microservice identification mainly starts from the system functionality perspective and does not take into account the actual business rules, which leads to microservice candidates not conforming to the concept of microservices. To address this challenge, we propose an automated approach to microservice identification that combines dynamic and static analysis and takes into account the actual business. Our proposed approach starts with a dynamic and static analysis of the monolithic system. Once the behavioral data of the system is collected, the behavioral data will be further processed according to our proposed guidelines. Then, the proposed approach calculates the degree of the correlation between classes in a monolithic system. Finally, we propose an improved clustering algorithm based on K-means to classify the classes in a monolithic system into different microservices. The proposed approach is validated by comparison with other approaches on open source projects.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Crowdsourcing Participants' Reputation on Trading Performance based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Crowdsourcing is an online activity in which employers openly convene crowdsourcing participants to participate in completing tasks through crowdsourcing platforms. Starting from the reputation of crowdsourcing participants, this paper analyzes the key factors that affect trading performance, builds a theoretical model of how the reputation of crowdsourcing participants affects trading performance, and empirically analyzes the data of the participants of the Zhubajie crowdsourcing platform. The research results show that credit rating, margin deposit, the number of employers served, three- month refund rate, and the number of penalties are the key factors affecting the trading performance, which significantly impact the crowdsourcing trading performance.

articleTitle: Restructuring hospital payment systems using middle platform technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In order to reshape the medical payment service system, we have designed a component based on the middle platform architecture. Our purpose is to standardized settlement and enhance work efficiency. Firstly, we Analyzed the application scenario of middle platform in hospital medical payment. Secondly, striped off the common functional modules, encapsulated the independent business interface. Thirdly, provided the ability to provide shared services, and expanded the application scenario of intelligent payment. After all this very fruitful work, the operation efficiency of the hospital payment system is improved, the coupling degree of the system is reduced, the cohesion is improved, and good results are obtained in practice. We think that the middle platform architecture can be combined according to the application requirements of the hospital, and it can also be extended for individual modules, which can meet the needs of hospital construction.

articleTitle: Aspect-level sentiment analysis based on attention-directed graph convolutional networks
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The aspect level emotion analysis task is mainly used to judge the emotional tendency of aspect words in the text, which belongs to the fine-grained emotion analysis task of the emotion analysis task. The existing sentiment analysis method is to classify emotions through a graph neural network. Because the syntax dependency tree generated by the use of tools have some errors, which are propagated to the construction of graph neural network, so the performance of the algorithm is affected. In this paper an attention-guided graph convolutional network model is proposed to solve the problem of errors in syntactic dependency tree information. Firstly, BiLSTM is used to obtain deep sentence information between aspect words and contextual words. Secondly, the semantic information with syntactic dependency tree structure is captured by the graph convolutional network, and the global semantic information of sentences is captured by the graph convolutional network with an attention mechanism. Finally, the two semantic information is combined. Global semantic information is used to mitigate errors in semantic information with syntactic dependency tree structure. The model was tested on Rest14, Rest16, and Laptopl4 data sets. The experimental results showed that the accuracy and F1 value increased by 1.12% and 1.39% on average compared with the baseline model.

articleTitle: Functional Logic Verification Method based on Probabilistic Model Checking
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Under the trend of systematization and intellectualization, complex missile systems show increasingly obvious characteristics of technology intensive, software intensive, long functional chain and complex logic. However, the common functional logic representation language SysML can not perform strict model checking. A device function logic verification method based on Markov chain is proposed. Firstly, the SysML model represented by Markov chain is transformed into the input model of probabilistic symbolic model checker; secondly, the probability calculation tree logic is used to analyze functional logic. Finally, the missile guidance is taken as an example. The results show that functional logic errors can be identified in the early stage of system development, which improves the speed and efficiency of system development.

articleTitle: Knowledge graph question answering system based on code defect
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In the current scenario of code defect aided search, the code defect knowledge is not accurate enough due to the singularity and island of code defect knowledge, so that developers and testers can not accurately use the defect knowledge. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a question answering system construction method based on code defect knowledge graph. Firstly, a large number of code defect knowledge is cleaned to obtain the entities and relationships of code defect knowledge, and the corresponding code defect knowledge graph is established. Then the combination of Bert model and Prompt makes the system better identify user intentions. The effectiveness of this method is verified based on the accuracy comparison with the commonly used models in this field. Experiments show that the combination of Bert model and Prompt makes this method more accurate in identifying user intention.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese word sense disambigution based on Prompt learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Word sense disambiguation is an important research topic in natural language processing. Its purpose is to determine the word meaning of a polysemous word in different contexts. In order to improve the efficiency of disambiguation, a Chinese word sense disambiguation model PL-WSD based on prompt learning is proposed. The model uses the knowledge base HowNet to obtain the representation of each word meaning in polysemous words, uses the way of prompt learning to calculate the similarity score of each word meaning in a specific context, and obtains the word meaning with the highest score as the final result of polysemous words. Experiments show that PL-WSD model is greatly improved compared with other models.

articleTitle: Combining i* and Service Blueprint for Service design:a case study of Fliggy
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Requirements modeling and software services design are two important activities in software life cycle. Although these two activities are at different stages of the software life cycle, they need to be considered together. When the requirements are defined clearly, the next task is service design. In the process of performing service design tasks, it is necessary to consider meeting the complex needs of users. In this paper, a method which combines iStar and service blueprint is proposed to support the crossover services design. The iStar framework is used to capture user intensions and the service blueprint is used to model the interactions between different components. To evaluate the proposed method, a case study is performed to illustrate the usage of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Compare the application of different algorithms in landslide displacement quantity prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The action mechanism of external factors on the change of landslide displacement quantity is very complex, in order to establish an efficient and accurate landslide displacement quantity prediction model. This paper will analyze 35 possible landslide displacement factors from temperature, soil temperature, humidity, soil moisture and rainfall. First, the data was processed with missing values and outliers, data segmentation, principal component analysis-dimensionality reduction, to obtain the main influencing landslide displacement factor. Then compare the regression predicted performance of MARS, Random Forest, ANN and SVM. The final regression prediction is ideal for the Random Forest and SVM algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of Food Safety Management Information System for Western Restaurant
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Food is the most basic material requirement for people’s development and survival, and the food industry is developing with the improvement of people’s living standards. Food safety is directly related to people’s health and life safety, and then to a country’s economic development and social harmony. At present, unsafe foods frequently appear, and many unsafe foods have led to mass public emergencies, resulting in adverse effects. Based on this, this paper first expounds the related concepts such as food safety and risk management informatization, and demonstrates the importance and necessity of food safety management informatization. Secondly, this paper studies and analyzes the current situation of food safety problems and information management of food safety in western restaurants in China. Finally, based on modern technology, this paper constructs a food safety management information system. The results show that the food safety management information system constructed in this paper has certain superior performance, and its stability can reach 94.19%. This system has certain operability and scientificalness, and it can promote the food safety supervision in catering industry by means of informationization and modernization.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a traditional martial arts follow-up training system based on virtual reality technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the popularity of the metaverse concept, virtual reality technology is increasingly being applied to all aspects of life, and its rapid development has far-reaching implications for the promotion of non-heritage culture. The movements of the inheritors are captured and given to the virtual characters; users who follow the movements of the virtual characters in the VR helmet will get an immersive sense of practice. This paper takes the background of traditional martial arts follow-up training and the dissemination of non-heritage culture, based on Unity3D software, integrates more than ten traditional martial arts, boxing methods and dances, and develops a traditional martial arts follow-up training system that is conducive to improving learning concentration and learning efficiency, in an attempt to create a Metaverse of non-heritage cultural forms, so that more people can gain a deeper understanding of traditional martial arts and obtain a better follow-up training effect.

articleTitle: Text Retrieval Method Integrating Scientific Knowledge and Pre-trained Model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The amount of scientific literature is growing year after year in tandem with the Internet’s fast expansion, and effective scientific literature retrieval is helpful for users’ scientific research work. There are unregistered technical terms in scientific literature, which causes the problem of semantic bias in the text representation of traditional retrieval methods, resulting in low retrieval precision, recall, and accuracy. Aiming at the above problems, a text retrieval method that integrates scientific knowledge and pre-trained models is proposed. This method initially mines new words from scientific publications using a novel word mining algorithm based on mutual information and adjacency entropy. And takes them as the full word mask object of the RoBERTa-wwm pre-training model for secondary pre-training, so that the pre-training model can integrate scientific knowledge and improve the ability to understand scientific knowledge. The matching semantic vector is then obtained by first encoding the original text using the secondary pre-training model, and then one-dimensional convolution is used for feature extraction to extract key text features through the Max-pooling layer. The completely linked layer is then mapped to the text characteristics, and the matching scores between texts are computed. According to experimental findings, our technique outperforms numerous other models on text retrieval tasks in the scientific sector.

articleTitle: Research on the segmentation of pension market based on K-means clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the acceleration of the aging process and the extension of life expectancy, the community is increasingly concerned about the pension problem. In order to better serve the needs of the elderly, accurately match the right pension mode, help pension industry in China to achieve more accurate marketing, improve customer recognition and core competitiveness, this article through the questionnaire survey to collect the elderly data, the K-means clustering algorithm for data processing and analysis, and according to the clustering results of endowment group classification in detail. The study found that it was most appropriate to cluster the sample data into four categories, and put forward suggestions according to the characteristics of the four groups of people.

articleTitle: Software design for recording and playback of multi-source heterogeneous data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The development of marine environment monitoring equipment has been improved by leaps and bounds in recent years. Numerous types of marine environment monitoring equipment have mushroomed with a wide range of high-performance capabilities. However, the existing data recording software cannot meet the demands of real-time and comprehensive data recording in view of the growing data types and the exponential data growth rate generated by various types of marine environment monitoring equipment. Based on the above-mentioned conundrum, this paper proposes a multi-source heterogeneous marine environmental data acquisition and storage method, which can record and replay multi-source heterogeneous data based upon the needs of real-time and accurate performance and also possess good compatibility and expandability.

articleTitle: A Sentence Semantic Matching Model Based on Cross-Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Most of the current deep learning based sentence semantic matching uses Siamese network to extract semantic features and then uses simple attention mechanism for interaction, which is effective for extracting coarse sentence semantics, but it is difficult to extract deep interaction matching information, and it is difficult to distinguish sentences with similar structures but different semantics. Therefore, a sentence semantic matching model based on cross-attention mechanism is proposed to build an interaction module with cross-attention mechanism to extract interaction matching information of sentences and learn richer interaction features of sentences; meanwhile, a Roformer-ft pretraining model is used to embed and encode sentences so that the model can learn fine-grained semantic differences of sentence pairs more effectively. It is demonstrated experimentally that the model in this paper exhibits better matching performance.

articleTitle: Multi-target tracking random finite set model based on signal parameter correlation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The target is generally equipped with a corresponding radiation source, and the signal parameter of the radiation source can be used as an important auxiliary parameter to improve the tracking performance of the electronic reconnaissance system to the target. For the practical application scenario of multi-tracking, we proposes an improved Gaussian mixture probability hypothesis density filter (GMPHD) filtering algorithm based on the correlation of radiation source signal parameters. By using the signal parameters to expand the dimension of the target’s motion state vector, the description of the target state is improved. Based on the statistical theory of random finite sets, the multi-target state is described as a random finite set, and GMPHD is used for tracking. Simulation results show that the use of signal parameters can enhance the precision of data correlation, thereby improving the performance of the trace.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Satellite Mission Planning Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: For the multi-satellite mission planning problem, a multi-satellite mission planning model is constructed by considering the constraints of satellite’s visibility window to the target, attitude transition, storage and energy consumption, and an improved genetic algorithm is proposed to solve the model. The algorithm adopts the real number coding method to improve the solution efficiency, introduces the adaptive mechanism and the elite retention strategy, which improves the problems that the genetic algorithm is easy to fall into local optimum and converge early. The effectiveness of the improved genetic algorithm for solving multi-star mission planning is verified through simulation case analysis, and it is compared and analyzed with the standard genetic algorithm. The results show that the well genetic algorithm can achieve faster convergence and better planning results, and has better adaptability to large-scale mission planning problems.

articleTitle: Analysis of Power Business User Value Mining Based on Data Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In recent years, China is comprehensively promoting major strategies such as "Big Data Strategy" and "Internet plus" Action Plan, which put forward clear requirements for promoting the sharing and development of energy big data and further expanding new business applications and services in energy production, circulation and consumption for commercial customers. Commercial users, as an important customer group served by power enterprises, have gradually changed their demand for electricity and energy from "using energy" to "making good use of energy", and the trend of differentiation and personalization has become increasingly prominent, which puts forward new expectations for power companies to provide accurate power marketing services. Power enterprises use big data to serve refined operation and precise marketing, and customer portrait is the foundation. Based on data intelligence technology, this study makes customer portraits of power commercial users, establishes a subdivision model of commercial customer groups, and puts forward corresponding accurate service strategies, which provides theoretical methods for fully exploiting the value of commercial customers.

articleTitle: Belief Entropy-based Uncertainty Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Mainstream methods of uncertainty and sensitivity analysis (e.g., Sobol indices) use probability distribution to characterize uncertainty and variance to quantify the extent of uncertainty. There are difficulties not yet well solved for these methods; for example, the calculation is too complex for high-dimensional spaces. In practice, input parameter distributions are usually estimated by experts. However, for modeling human uncertainty, some studies have shown that uncertainty theory would be a more reliable mathematical tool than probability theory. Based on uncertainty theory, a new method — Belief Entropy-based Uncertainty Analysis (BEUA) is proposed, which uses belief degree distribution to characterize uncertainty and belief entropy (BE) to quantify the extent of uncertainty. An analytical equation is derived based on the BE decomposition to calculate the contribution proportion of each parameter to the output uncertainty. Compared with variance-based methods, BEUA is much easier and applicable to high-dimensional spaces and does not require many sampling calculations. In the end, BEUA is tested on nonlinear models.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Innovation Configuration path of New Energy Vehicle Enterprises Based on Big Data Analysis : —Qualitative Comparative Analysis Based on fsQCA
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Based on the theoretical framework of "technology -organization-environment", six antecedent variables are selected, and the model fsQCA method is used to identify the path of driving the digital innovation of new energy vehicle enterprises, which can be summarized into three configurations: "technology oriented-environmental promotion", "environment oriented-technology & organization supporting" and "technology oriented -government promotion". This study is expected to provide a theoretical basis for the new energy vehicle enterprises in China to optimize the allocation of digital resources and accelerate the pace of digital transformation.

articleTitle: Cloud Offloading Technique based on an Optimized Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Cloud computing is both a service model and a computing model. As a service model, users have certain requirements for their service quality, either to obtain the most efficient service in the shortest time or to obtain the most fluent service at the lowest cost. Virtualization technology encapsulates a large number of heterogeneous computing, storage and network resources for users to access and use. A cloud resource scheduling algorithm based on improved ant colony algorithm is proposed. Time cost constraint function is created to redefine the pheromone, and a load adaptive function is introduced to calculate the ant transition probability. Simulation of cloud resource scheduling on the Cloud Sim cloud simulation platform shows that when the cost is unchanged, the optimized parameter combination enables the scheduling algorithm to complete the scheduling task more efficiently, with the lowest scheduling time and cost.

articleTitle: Efficient Context-Aware Edge Computing Algorithm in Mobile Cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Edge computing provides a feasible technical solution to solve the problem of resource and energy supply constraints in terminal device deep learning applications. By migrating part of the deep learning application computing from the terminal to the cloud edge server, the computing pressure of the terminal device can be greatly relieved, and the energy consumption of the terminal can also be reduced to a certain extent. However, in the process of computing migration, the context switching loss of deep learning applications results in a long delay. This paper studies the problem of minimizing the completion time of deep learning applications under edge computing. We model the deep learning application as a task graph, and consider the constraints such as task switching delay, energy consumption and task dependency. Without changing the structure of the task graph, we transform it into a task scheduling-based application completion time minimization problem. In this paper, we first design a parallel scheduling algorithm based on greedy search. Considering the loss of context switching and the dependence of task data, we can allocate tasks to multiple processors for parallel processing by calculating the expected completion time of tasks, thus reducing the completion time of applications. Based on the experimental results, the greedy scheduling algorithm and comparison algorithm are analyzed and verified to optimize the completion time of different depth learning applications.

articleTitle: Research on Named Entity Recognition Method Based on BERT-MD-RNN-CRF
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low recognition accuracy and poor model recall of unstructured data in named entity recognition tasks, a named entity recognition method based on BERT-MD-RNN-CRF is proposed: firstly, the BERT pre-trained language model is used to extract character vectors containing context information in the text, and the vectors are used as model input vectors. Then, the multidimensional recurrent neural network and attention network are used to operate on the span information matrix to enhance the semantic connection between the spans. Conditional random field CRF is used to learn the internal relationships between labels to ensure their sequence; Finally, the augmented span information matrix is classified by span to identify named entities. Experiments show that compared with the traditional span method, this method can effectively enhance the semantic dependency feature between spans, thereby improving the recall rate of named entity recognition. This method improves the recall rate by 0.31% compared with the traditional method on the ACE2005 English dataset, and achieves a higher Fi value.

articleTitle: Analysis of Real-time Image Target Detection and Recognition Algorithm Based on Video Stream
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In order to further strengthen the management and control of information maintenance operations, a real-time image recognition algorithm based on video stream is proposed. By establishing an information maintenance business risk analysis model, the operation and maintenance behavior and input/output flow information of the information system can be automatically identified, and the operation and maintenance process can be analyzed in real time. Command operation, log exception analysis, personnel abnormal behavior, work order text and other information can quickly locate abnormal operations and alert operational risks, realize unified monitoring, continuous positioning and risk warning of remote operation and maintenance of the information system, aiming to enhance the life cycle management and control capabilities of the overall information maintenance system, reduce maintenance risks, and improve the quality and efficiency of information operation.

articleTitle: The multi-cycle production routing collaborative scheduling problem with time optimization under uncertain environment
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the intensification of market competition and the increase of uncertainty, the rapid response of enterprises and their supply chains to market demand is becoming more and more crucial. This paper focuses on demand and time uncertainty which affects the response time, and studies the time optimization of production routing collaborative scheduling problem. Because the production routing collaborative scheduling problem can be regarded as the integration of production planning problem and vehicle routing problem, the response time are both affected by the processes of production and transportation. The minimization expectation total completion time model is first proposed, and then the total cost constraints including production, storage and transportation costs are considered, as well as more strict response time constraints for each customer in each period. Then, the certainty equivalent transformation of the proposed model is carried out to extract the variance and the confidence level of the uncertain variables and then make uncertainty analysis. Finally, numerical experiments are made to solve the model, and the uncertainty analysis of time and demand is carried.

articleTitle: GPU Resource Scheduling Management System Based on Work Order
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the development of "Internet+" ecology and the popularization of the concept "Internet of Everything", the management of various physical resources has been increasingly intelligentized. As an important research resource in the information industry, the Gpu management should keep pace with the times and achieve the goal of management automation and high data visualization. Although large-scale enterprises, such as Alibaba Cloud and Tencent Cloud, have developed their own sophisticated Gpu management solutions, some small-scale enterprises and universities are still exploring the management of Gpu cluster resources. All kinds of defects in the management system, the cumbersome operation process of management, and the inefficient management capability have resulted in the inefficient use of the infrastructure and invisible loss of assets.This program aims to explore the following issues: how to keep pace with the times, how to meet different needs of users best, and how to minimize the impact of the new system on the existing application process of cluster resource. As a result, this program takes the Gpu cluster management system of Beijing Information Science & Technology University as an example, focusing on solving the existing Gpu management problems to design a customized, automated and highly available intelligent resource scheduling management system.

articleTitle: Research on Cost Estimation Algorithm of Battlefield Road Damage Repair
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In modern warfare, logistics transportation support is an important part, so the enemy will try their best to destroy our important traffic lines to cut off the links between important hub cities, at this time, the cost estimation of re-establishing links between important hub cities can greatly assist commanders to make decisions, and the efficiency of the cost estimation algorithm will affect the timeliness of decision-making. It plays a key role in winning the battle. In This paper, according to the condition of the destroyed road and the repaired road, aiming at the problem that the complexity of the traditional DFS algorithm and BFS algorithm is too high, and the Hungarian algorithm, 2-sat and other graph algorithms are difficult to meet the multi-constraint conditions, the state compression dynamic programming algorithm is used to calculate the minimum cost of restoring the interconnection relationship. Dijkstra and minimum Steiner tree are used to optimize the algorithm, which improves the efficiency of the algorithm and solves the problem of cost estimation of road damage repair in complex environment.

articleTitle: Research on Cross-project Defect Prediction Based on Instance Migration Method
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The field of software engineering data mining has become increasingly interested in cross-project defect prediction (CPDP), which uses defect codes from other projects to develop prediction models, addressing the problem of insufficient data in the model construction process. However, the source and target projects usually have large differences in data distribution, which reduces the prediction performance. Based on the learning idea of instance migration, the distribution of target project features is changed to be close to the distribution of source project features, thus improving the performance of cross-project defect prediction. Specifically, the cross-project software defect prediction is investigated by combining software metric features with instance migration methods. First, we analyze the difficulty of class imbalance in the training set and extract features from the instances in the training set. Then the idea of improved AdaBoost is proposed. Finally, the algorithm based on instance migration is proposed and experimented, and the result analysis shows the effectiveness and feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Online Face Recognition System Based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In the real environment, face recognition based on video or image files is easily affected by the acquisition angle, expression, illumination and other conditions, and general machine learning and pattern recognition face recognition algorithms also have problems of accuracy and adaptability. Therefore, based on the current technical development, this paper takes the deep learning algorithm model as the core, uses MTCNN multi-task convolutional neural network with FaceNet model to complete the face detection and face recognition of video image files, and completes the corresponding data training with the help of Keras framework and TensorFlow class library to form an intelligent machine that can support the call of Web server. At the same time, ASP.NET framework and C# language are used to build the Web server, design and develop each functional module, improve the deployment of the corresponding API interface, build the front-end interactive interface, and form the online face recognition system. The overall design of the system adopts B/S architecture, which supports users to access the Web Server through simple request operation to complete the corresponding face detection and recognition of the input video image files, and return the comparison recognition results to the front page for display. The system will greatly improve the precision and accuracy of face recognition, and make a useful attempt to further expand the application scenarios of face recognition technology.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Transaction Method Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the continuous development and wide application of Internet technology, people are entering a digital life. Businesses have released their own digital assets to improve user experience and increase user engagement through consumer websites, virtual currencies, and more. The main purpose of this paper is to study blockchain-based multi-agent transaction methods. First, through an overview of the basic theory of blockchain, the core technology of blockchain is introduced. Combined with the current multi-agent transaction method, the research and analysis of the shortcomings that still exist. Finally, based on the decentralization and immutability of blockchain, the subject of this paper is studied and analyzed. Experimental studies have shown that, compared with traditional trading systems, blockchain-based multi-agent trading systems have better performance in many aspects.

articleTitle: Progressive Order Insertion Dynamic Scheduling Method Considering Production Capacity
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In the process of flexible manufacturing cells, the disturbance of single insertion will cause a delay of existing production orders. In this paper, a scheduling model is established to minimize order delay and maximum order completion time for the rescheduling problem of a flexible job shop. Design a progressive order insertion rearrangement strategy, and set the buffer time for inserting orders. Determine the start time of rescheduling by buffer time. In terms of algorithm, NEH heuristic scheduling is improved according to the characteristics of the model. Design the initial sequence generation rule index factor. Use algorithms to solve the model. The simulation results show that the progressive order insertion rearrangement strategy can effectively reduce the order delay compared with the complete rescheduling, which verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.
