articleTitle: GOSGAN: An Adaptive Atomic Force Microscope Imaging Repair Model for Cell Scanning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In recent years, Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) has played an irreplaceable role in cell biology as it can measure the local mechanical information of individual cells while observing the surface morphology of cells. To address the problems of long scanning time and poor image quality, this paper attempts to introduce a super-resolution method to optimize the images in order to reduce the imaging time, reduce probe loss and improve the image quality. The proposed method is based on the existing super-resolution method of generative adversarial networks and is designed to introduce a self-attentive information fusion module to enhance the organic fusion of a priori and input while improving the richness of the a priori information encapsulated in the network, and to propose GOSGAN. In addition, a large-scale data generation model and a targeted image degradation model are introduced to address the problem of difficult access to AFM data. The final experiment achieves a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity ratio (SSIM) of 26.8 dB and 0.92, respectively, on its own validation set.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a face recognition classroom attendance system based on the Django framework
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Compare the current situation of classroom management at home and abroad, take certain feasibility analyses of classroom attendance management systems at home and abroad, and investigate and explore the problems encountered in classroom management in universities nowadays. We design a platform for classroom attendance management of college students and build a modular classroom attendance system, which is mainly divided into a face recognition module, student management module, classroom management module, and database interface module.

articleTitle: Privacy Preserving Approach to Communication Data Mining Based on Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Current traditional privacy protection methods for communication data achieve functions such as anti-tampering and resistance to single point of failure attacks through edge computing, which leads to poor data protection due to the lack of aggregation processing of user behavior. In this regard, a privacy protection method for communication data mining based on federated learning is proposed. A secure aggregation protocol is constructed to aggregate user interaction behaviors, and a user sensitivity scoring mechanism is constructed to establish a privacy protection model for communication data mining. In the experiments, the privacy-preserving effect of the proposed method is verified. The analysis of the experimental results shows that the data privacy protection model constructed by the proposed method has a high degree of convergence of the model and has a more excellent data privacy protection performance.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis Method of Spare Parts Allocation for Power Communication Network Based on Dig Data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: To solve the problem that the spare parts of power communication network cannot be inventoried data and tracked comprehensively in real time, the statistical analysis method of spare parts for power communication network allocation based on big data which includes five core functions of instant inventory statistical analysis, spare parts outbound statistics, power communication network spare parts interchange statistical analysis, spare parts procurement prediction analysis and spare parts detection statistical analysis is proposed. The spare parts instant inventory statistical analysis method is designed to enhance the global control of spare parts information by depot managers. The network-wide spare parts procurement forecasting algorithm can effectively prevent spare parts shortage and improve inventory utilization. The method guarantees the safe and stable operation of the power communication network.

articleTitle: Research on the technical framework of intelligent and efficient analysis and mining of big data in electric power
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The application of intelligent technology in electric power enterprises is an important content of reform, and the intelligent analysis platform of electric power big data is an important content of intelligent upgrading. This paper expounds the basic methods of data mining technology, puts forward the improved algorithm of data mining, analyzes the functional requirements and design principles of intelligent data mining technology, puts forward the basic architecture design and technical foundation of intelligent data mining technology platform, and describes the basic functions of each module in detail. Finally, the platform is applied to the actual power enterprises, and the practice shows that the application of the platform has achieved good results.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Distributed Real-time Database System for Massive Data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the continuous development of strong smart grid construction, the existing real-time database cannot meet the requirements of tens of millions of measuring points and large capacity storage. This paper analyzes the objective demand of the massive data of the power grid and the technical bottleneck of the existing real-time database, introduces the distributed technology into the field of real-time database, studies and designs the distributed real-time database management system for the massive data of the power grid, which can provide technical support for the construction and development of a strong smart grid.

articleTitle: Implementation and Research of Vivado HLS’s Function on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Vivado HLS is a high-level comprehensive tool, which can be well applied to FPGA boards. It can help engineers overcome the difficulties when they are developing in Register Transfer Level (RTL). This paper will use Matlab language and C++ language to design an adaptive notch filter, and verify results of the output by Vivado HLS through the waveform output in Matlab, The "Test bench" and "Co-simulation" in the software are used for collaborative verification to test its real efficiency and functionality. Practice has proved that the best scheme obtained by Vivado HLS can well meet the application requirements after multiple optimizations and iterations. Using its own capabilities, the time of development, debugging and verification is greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Research on the Policy of Transportation Data Management Based on PMC Index
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Data management related policies play a guiding role in the digital transformation of the whole society. Under the guidance of policies, data sharing and data security have been paid attention to and standardized to a certain extent. The sorting and evaluation of existing policies helps to provide a quantitative basis for policy improvement and optimization in the future. Based on the data management related policy texts published by governments at all levels in China, this study selects relevant data management policies in the field of transportation, conducts quantitative analysis on the policy texts based on text analysis tools and PMC policy evaluation model, obtains the PMC index of each policy, and draws the PMC surface chart. Each policy is evaluated according to the PMC index, and its shortcomings are found out by studying the multiple input-output table and the PMC index table, and the methods to overcome these shortcomings through optimization are proposed.

articleTitle: An ensemble approach: Combining Wisdom from Truth Discovery Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, there is a large amount of conflicting data on the network. It is becoming increasingly important to identify the true information. Truth discovery becomes a hot research topic, it identifies object truth while estimating source reliability. Although many methods have been proposed, they are all applicable to specific scenarios, and none of them can be applied to all scenarios or always better than others. That is, there is no one-fit-all solution. In addition, objects have different difficulties. Accurately assessing the difficulty of each object is conducive to improving the accuracy of the truth discovery. In order to solve the above problem, we propose a distributed ensemble truth discovery model (DETD), which combines different results output by base truth discovery algorithms, while considering the difficulty of each object and computing the reliability of base algorithms. Experimental results show that the proposed DETD model can effectively estimate the truths of objects on two real-world datasets.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Per Capita Disposable Income of Rural Residents in Shandong Province Based on GM (1,1) Model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Residents' disposable income refers to the disposable income that residents can use. The changing trend of living standards in a country or region plays a decisive role in the consumption expenditure of residents. Based on the original data source in Shandong Statistical Yearbook, this paper analyzes the per capita disposable income of Shandong Province from 2011 to 2021, and establishes a GM (1,1) forecasting model to analyze and predict the per capita disposable income of rural residents in Shandong Province in the next five years. The model results show that the GM (1,1) forecasting model is suitable for forecasting the rural per capita disposable income in the next five years, and the precision is relatively high. Judging from the forecast results, the gap between the per capita disposable income of rural residents and urban areas is still large. In order to narrow the gap between urban and rural per capita income and promote the common prosperity of farmers, local governments also need to gradually lake measures to increase The income of rural residents and strengthen assistance to rural residents to increase their income.

articleTitle: On-Line Detection For Laser Additive Manufacturing Based On Temperature Field Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Laser additive manufacturing is a thermal process in which the laser beam dynamically melts and solidifies the powder material, not only the solidification structure is dominated by the heat transfer process, but the formation of various defects is also closely related to the thermal history of the forming process. In this paper, the temperature field characteristics of several surface defects in laser additive manufacturing were explored by using numerical simulation method, and experimental verification was carried out. The results confirm that it is an effective way for online defect detection by using the temperature characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on Machine Translation (MT) System Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the deepening of globalization and the rapid development of human society and economic society in the world, the demand for machine translation in human society is also increasing rapidly, and the progress of artificial intelligence technology has put forward new requirements for the quality of machine translation. At the same time, the development of machine translation research has set a benchmark for other fields of natural language processing. Therefore, the research on machine translation not only has high practical value, but also can promote the progress of the theoretical research on natural language processing. Based on the idea of deep learning, this paper selects English language features as feature parameters, uses fine-tuning Python model training technology and feature-based deep learning method, and conducts deep reinforcement learning on Anglo-German MACHINE translation model. The comparative experiment of Indian English-German neural machine translation model shows that, The machine translation system based on deep learning is obviously better than traditional machine translation, and the translation effect is obviously improved.

articleTitle: Fusion recommendation algorithm based on DeepWalk and Item-Based collaborative filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Collaborative filtering techniques have been applied to personalised recommendation systems in recommender systems. However, with the gradual increase in the number of platform users and goods, the user rating data on the entire project matrix is extremely sparse, resulting in the inaccuracy of the prediction results. DeepWalk, on the other hand, still performs well when the data is sparse. Therefore, DeepWalk is introduced into collaborative filtering, and a fusion recommendation algorithm based on DeepWalk and collaborative filtering is proposed to reduce the impact of cold start and sparsity on the recommendation results. Experiments show that the proposed fusion recommendation algorithm has higher recommendation accuracy when the data is sparse compared with other traditional algorithms, which improves the recommendation quality to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Research on The Design of Enterprise Cost Warning System Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Crisis prediction for enterprises has been generated in the last century, providing an important reference for investors and managers. Meanwhile the recent emergence of machine learning, deep learning and other data mining techniques are slowly applied to the corporate crisis problem. It is important research significance to provide a strong noise-resistant, less disturbing and high-performance early warning model for enterprises through more extensive data research. In this paper, we introduce an optimized convolutional neural network model based on introducing an attention mechanism in the early warning system and compare the effect with other models. The experimental results show that the traditional Logistic model is less effective in predicting the early stage of the financial crisis, and the gap between the integrated learning and deep learning decreases in the approaching years. The performance of the convolutional neural network can surpass other models after adding the attention mechanism, and the most prominent discriminative effect is obtained in this paper.

articleTitle: An Application Study of Stochastic Service Systems Based on Operations Search
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the improvement of our economic level in recent years, the accompanying problems in operation and management such as impracticality of random services, unreasonable material placement, mistakes in site planning and unreasonable deployment of human resources have gradually become bottlenecks that restrict the development and growth of enterprises. Operations research is widely used in economic management systems to co-ordinate limited resources such as people, money and materials in enterprises and to provide a scientific basis for decision-making. Using the theory of operations research can provide a scientific approach to solving these problems. The paper focuses on the principles of operations research and the steps involved in dealing with problems, as well as introducing the application of operations research in the field of economic management, starting with some examples. The main research analyzes the optimization models and algorithms of two types of systems in the field of economic management by combining the principles of computational operations research with stochastic services and optimal scheduling, and conducts simulation experiments using VC++6.0 or Matlab6.1. These two types of problems exist in large numbers in real production life, so the study of optimisation models and algorithmic simulations of these two types of problems has great practical and social value. By studying the application of stochastic service theory to fast food restaurants, banks, video-on-demand and web access, different mathematical models are developed in these areas, and their algorithms and experimental results are analysed. The focus is on the application of queuing theory to video-on-demand systems. Based on the popularity of programmes divided into two categories, popular and cold, a popularity-based video stream control method is proposed, the instantaneous transfer probability of the system is analysed, and a bandwidth prediction formula for video streams of different popularity is given. This queuing analysis research method can be applied to other similar random service systems.

articleTitle: Research on the prediction of e-commerce platform user churn based on Random Forest model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: According to a survey conducted by Brain & Company, a leading consulting firm, for every 5% reduction in customer churn rate, company profits will increase by 25%-95%. The rising cost of customer acquisition on online platforms in recent years and the rising market saturation today makes improving user quality a pressing issue for platforms to address, increasing user stickiness and reducing customer chum has been a long-term solution for the development of online e-commerce platforms. Based on the live e-commerce dataset of a platform provided by AliCloud’s Tianchi data platform, after data preprocessing, this paper first visualizes some variables in the data set based on Python programming language, and then analyzes the correlation of the influencing factors. It is concluded that the duration of user platform usage, the average amount of cash returned last month and some other variables have a significant impact on the loss of ecommerce platform users. Then a Random Forest mathematical model is established to predict the possibility of user churn. Finally, confusion matrix and classified decision tree methods are used to test the rationality of the prediction model. The prediction accuracy of both methods is more than 90%, and the model is reasonable. The ultimate purpose of this study is to analyze the important factors that affect the loss of users for e-commerce platforms, and provide feasible suggestions to reduce the loss of users on the platform.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Warehouse Management System Based on Vuetify 3.0 Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Warehouse management system is very important for the daily management of modern warehouse. Based on the latest Vuetify 3.0 framework, this paper has designed and implemented a lightweight warehouse management system for daily warehouse management, which can realize the functions of viewing, searching, creating, modifying and viewing detailed information of goods information. The system uses modular thinking to separately design the functions of goods information display, search, creation, modification and detailed information viewing in warehouse management. The front end uses simple web design to enable the warehouse administrator to quickly switch between goods information display, search, creation, modification and detailed information viewing interfaces. The warehouse administrator’s modification information of warehouse goods information will be uploaded in real time and saved to the background server. This enables the warehouse goods management function to take effect in real time. Through a large number of experiments and tests, this paper shows that the system has greatly realized the digital management function of the warehouse, and it has the advantages of simple operation, high execution efficiency, strong stability, and good scalability.

articleTitle: Defense Strategy of Adversarial Attack
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The adversarial attack technique is to cause slight interference to the deep learning model through adversarial samples so that the model’s prediction accuracy drops sharply. The FGSM method mainly utilizes the gradient descent method in the neural network, back-transmits the original data, and adds perturbations to obtain adversarial samples. Then such adversarial samples are generated for a specific model and a specific batch of data. This paper uses the generated adversarial examples to test LeNet and VGG11, VGG13, VGG16, and VGG19. For the rigor of the experiment, this paper uses the adversarial samples generated by VGG19 to test VGG11, VGG13, and VGG16. Through the above experiments, this paper obtains the aggressiveness of the same adversarial samples against different models and the commonality between the adversarial samples generated by different models so that we can get some valuable ideas in analyzing the characteristics of adversarial samples and defense strategies.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Text Classifier Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the continuous development and application of artificial intelligence technology, text classification gradually changes from shallow learning mode to deep learning mode. Deep learning mode has obvious improvement in process design, model construction and accuracy of classification prediction results. Therefore, this paper takes text classification as the research object, based on the deep learning algorithm, builds a text classifier by using TextCNN Convolutional Neural Network, and trains the corresponding model with TensorFlow deep learning framework and Keras advanced neural network API in Python environment, so as to form an intelligent text classifier that can be called by Web Server. In addition, ASP.NET framework and C# language will be selected to complete the development of Web Server, improve the definition and deployment of functions and data interfaces, and generate a Web-based text classification system. The overall design of the system conforms to the B/S architecture standard, which supports users to complete the classification results of the input text content by simple operation of the client interface. After testing, the text classifier based on TextCNN has the ability to quickly extract local features, and it is more suitable for the classification prediction of long-sequence text content, and its execution efficiency and classification accuracy are obviously improved.

articleTitle: Research on Network Structure Analysis of English Learning in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: This paper uses the social network analysis method to analyze the network structure of English-related learning communities on Weibo platform, and analyzes the reasons for its formation under different network and participant backgrounds. By using the complex system research software Gephi to analyze the social network of the data and the degree centrality of the key nodes, this paper finds that all kinds of online English learning networks are sparse, and when the network is small, it will have a positive impact on individual English learning in the community. Highly centralized network members play a leading role, and most of these users have user names similar to community keywords. Based on the analysis of social media English learning, this paper puts forward some suggestions to improve the effectiveness of online English teaching from the perspective of network science.

articleTitle: Application of Environmental Monitoring and Control System in Agricultural Production
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: China's agriculture is gradually moving from traditional agriculture to digital agriculture and smart agriculture. Accelerating the breakthrough of key agricultural core technologies and solidly promoting agricultural modernization are the key to the development of smart agriculture. Intelligent monitoring of agricultural greenhouses is an important way to realize agricultural modernization. However, most of the existing greenhouses have backward management concepts, low industry development level, lack of a complete and standardized production management system, and low level of agricultural facilities leads to low resource utilization. In the process of agricultural production, it is difficult to scientifically monitor and analyze the indicators such as temperature, light and soil water content, and the application amount of various nutrients in the process of crop growth can not be accurately controlled, which affects the agricultural planting benefits. Based on this, the author designed an agricultural greenhouse monitoring system based on the Internet of things. The system uses STM32 as the main control chip and is connected with a series of sensors to monitor the environmental parameters in the greenhouse in real time and adjust the environmental parameters in the greenhouse in time, so as to achieve the set standards, adjust the growth cycle, improve quality and increase production.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning in Monitoring and Warning of Network Public Opinion in Universities
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: This paper uses the deep learning technology of convolutional neural network (CNN) and Word2vec to improve the accuracy of network public opinion monitoring in universities. This paper uses crawler technology to obtain data from Sina Weibo, Zhihu, Baidu Tieba and other websites, preprocesses hot topics related to public opinion in colleges and universities, uses Word2vec model to generate word vectors, uses CNN to extract features and classify emotional tendencies, and establishes a more effective monitoring and early warning system of public opinion in colleges and universities. This study has good theoretical value and practical significance to further strengthen the work of news and public opinion in Colleges and universities, and to enhance the ability of governance and the modernization level of governance system in Colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Optimisation of Existing Marketing Strategies for Cross-border E-commerce ERP Products Based on Big Data Statistical Foundation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Abstract: Founded in 2017, Company X was established to serve Amazon merchants and provide them with professional ERP software products. During its 5-year development, it has provided professional ERP software product services for tens of thousands of Amazon e-commerce merchants. The ERP products created by Company X can provide cross-border Amazon merchants with one-stop solutions for refined operations by integrating system modules such as procurement, warehousing, logistics, advertising, customer service, and finance, striving to make business simpler for cross-border merchants.This paper is dedicated to researching the optimization of ecommerce system, combining the modern big data statistics, analyzing and optimizing the existing marketing strategy of cross-border e-commerce products, improving on the original yanking e-commerce marketing strategy, getting the optimized ecommerce marketing strategy, optimizing the marketing strategy for cross-border e-commerce ERP products, and then conforming to the modern cross-border e-commerce marketing market, making cross-border e-commerce products in marketing achieve more excellent results.

articleTitle: Multidimensional Market Unstructured Information Quantification and Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Stock market volatility is influenced by a combination of multidimensional market information. This study is based on a multidimensional market information perspective in response to a single dimensional study, and synergistically considers the combined effects of international, domestic, macro and micro factors to achieve the research objective of better analyzing stock market operation and identifying stock market risks. For the massive and rapidly spreading Internet information, it is obviously difficult to complete the work of emotion extraction of text information by relying on the manual method of judging its influence trend. Therefore, it is one of the key tasks of this paper to automate the work of extracting and quantifying sentiment from unstructured text data by technical means.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient optimization strategy for simulation task scheduling based on supercomputing platform
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: To address the problems of high energy consumption and underutilization of resources in the supercomputing platform of the grid center, a regression analysis is used to deal with the relationship between resource usage data and energy consumption, and an energy consumption evaluation model is created. The proposed energy consumption assessment model is combined with the existing simulation task scheduling strategy to propose an energy consumption-aware load balancing strategy to improve the overall resource utilization rate from the perspective of improving the load balancing of computing nodes on the platform; a node adjustment algorithm based on real-time CPU utilization is proposed to dynamically adjust the number of nodes involved in computing. The task-node mapping relationship is scheduled according to the load of computing nodes to reduce the energy consumption of the platform without significant impact on the execution time of existing power simulation tasks. The energy consumption modeling and performance testing of the scheduling scheme are carried out under Linux system and through simulated simulation environment such as CloudSim. The experimental results show that the energy consumption evaluation model based on the system resource utilization rate can achieve about 95% accuracy; the total energy consumption of the two scheduling strategies is basically the same, and there is about 16% energy saving compared with the basic scheduling strategy and about 11% energy saving compared with the Max-Min scheduling strategy.

articleTitle: Invading Deep Neural Information Management Systems by Adaptive Multi-Gradient Based Method
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The applications of deep learning have been widely employed in many specific domains (e.g., computer vision and language processing). The research on the security and privacy of deep neural networks (DNNs) has drawn much attention related to adversarial attacks and defense on DNNs. To provide a simple yet effective adversarial learning resource for building adversarial security, we formulate imperceptible adversarial perturbations in an adaptive multi-gradient learning manner, which calls a few adaptive operators on gradient-based terms. First, the proposed work searches for the input gradient based on the source representation in deep neural models. Then, fusing three adaptive gradient-based mechanisms to form the perturbed terms, which improves the capability of the generated samples to search the decision boundaries between original and adversarial domains directly. We compare the proposed work to other gradient-based adversarial attack methods in fooling convolutional neural networks in the field of computer vision. Experimental results reveal that adversarial examples generated by the introduced approach show surpassing effectiveness in fooling deep neural networks. It manifests fewer pixel changes in generated adversarial examples both on and norm constraints with specific attack strategies, respectively.

articleTitle: Interaction-Enhanced Textual Similarity Matching Distance Measurement – Exploration on Chinese
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Textual similarity matching is one of the most valuable tasks in natural language processing. Meanwhile, due to the wide development of applications and increase in requirements, various subtasks are proposed and expected to be resolved. In addition, Chinese, which owns the largest population of native speakers, introduced more challenges because of its different grammar and characteristics. In this project, we explore the best design of representation, interaction, and prediction layers for Chinese textual similarity matching by extensive experiments on two public datasets. Results prove that the precise interaction paradigm and unlearnable distance metric is more suitable for matching task considering effectiveness and efficiency. And for the option of representation structure, we should simultaneously consider textual information distribution within datasets and computational cost.

articleTitle: Design and research of intra cluster routing protocol for Vehicle Ad hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The intra cluster routing protocol designed in this paper is based on the trust model of vehicle nodes. The trust model is mainly composed of the reliability of vehicle nodes and other attribute factors of vehicle nodes. The cloud data center uses principal component analysis to calculate the trust value. The attributes of the vehicle nodes in the cluster are forwarded to the cluster head along with the Hello message packet. The cluster head forms an attribute list and sends it to the cloud data center, which calculates the trust value. When there are multiple paths to choose, the vehicle nodes in the cluster take the trust value of each node on the path as an important basis for path selection, forming the routing process in the cluster. By adding trust computation, reliable data transmission between vehicle nodes can be guaranteed. The experimental results show that the intra cluster routing protocol designed by the trust model in this scheme is effective and feasible, and the maximum speed of vehicle nodes has an impact on the performance of the routing algorithm.

articleTitle: Bus Stop Information Data Collection and Analysis Technology Based on Web Crawler Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In this study, we use the means of web crawler to obtain the information data of bus stops in specific cities by using 8684 website and Baidu map as the data platform, and conduct data cleaning and visual analysis on the detailed data of the stops to analyze the distribution of urban stops. Finally, based on this, a city bus stop information collection and analysis software is formed to make up for the incomplete data acquisition of existing software. It can realize the collection of bus stop information data in different cities, which is of great significance in the field of traffic planning and big data analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprises’ Response to Emergencies Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The outbreak of the Corona Virus Disease 2019 quickly became an international and domestic public health emergency in the spotlight. Under the impact of the epidemic, private companies, especially offline businesses, have been hit hard. Therefore, private enterprises today need to pay more attention to enhancing "organizational resilience" and improving their resilience in the face of disruptions and disruptions caused by major emergencies. In this study, three machine learning methods are compared with traditional linear regression models to analyze the impact of organizational resilience on the response of small and medium-sized private enterprises to the epidemic. The same interview-based policy recommendations to boost the organizational resilience of small and medium-sized private enterprises in three northeastern provinces are proposed. The results of this survey show that the degree of influence of resilience commitment is the greatest among the main factors affecting the resilience of enterprises. According to the policy demands of enterprises, the government should help enterprises with difficulties in the epidemic by giving financial policy support, providing cost subsidies, and improving the national emergency management system.

articleTitle: VR-based Image Training Sample Generation System for Substation Inspection
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In the power industry, the defect detection of power equipment is gradually changing from the traditional manual inspection to intelligent fault identification. The number of substation defect image samples is small, the type is small, and the data is unbalanced. The lack of defect sample data sets in deep learning limits the generalization and accuracy of defect recognition algorithms. In view of the above problems, a simulation software design scheme for substation inspection image sample generation is proposed. The three-dimensional modeling is used to restore the scene and power equipment of the substation site, simulate various faults and defects that may occur in the equipment, and automatically mark the fault point and fault type. The simulation software can quickly generate a large number of substation defect image samples, which provides a new idea for the expansion and improvement of substation inspection image data set.

articleTitle: Gazetteer Enhanced Named Entity Recognition for Musical User-Generated Content
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The vast amount of social information distributed over various electronic media channels, namely User-Generated Content (UGC), has been the fastest growing source of information in recent years. Named Entity Recognition (NER) researches on UGC in specific business areas such as music have potential widespread application prospects, such as user intention analysis and products recommendation. Current neural NER models achieve remarkable performance on standard benchmark tasks. It is challenging to deal with noisy, low-context text and complex, emerging entities in real-world setting. A new approach has been proposed to solve the issues. It learns character-level and token-level knowledge simultaneously, and incorporates gazetteers as external knowledge with them which augment the understanding of the music UGC. Experimental results show that our approach achieves an improvement of 15 points in F1 score compared with the modern baseline.

articleTitle: Risk early warning and response of PPP projects in characteristic towns based on fuzzy group decision- making and matter-element model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to identify the whole process risk factors and risk early warning of PPP projects in characteristic towns. First of all, based on the 21 key risk factors of PPP projects in characteristic towns identified in the early stage, this paper constructs a life-cycle risk early warning indicator system. Secondly, through the establishment of a fuzzy matter-element model to judge the risk alarm, send out early warning signals, and analyze the response measures to the early warning results. Finally, take LW characteristic town as an example to verify the feasibility and rationality of the risk early warning model, and provide some reference for PPP projects in characteristic towns to deal with risks.

articleTitle: Optimization of power transmission and transformation site construction network based on edge computing
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In view of the high calculation delay and computing serious waste of resources in the current substation construction network , adopt the introduction of edge computing technology to calculate near the terminal of the costs. A computing resource allocation method based on priority and weighting algorithm is proposed to allocate computing resources. First , the priority of computing tasks is sorted ,and then the weighted value is set by computing resources and normalization coefficients to perform computing resource allocation for each task. Using Kata containers instead ordinary virtual machines , low cost and low latency of Kata Containers , enable edge computing technology to play a greater role in the construction network of substations. Comparing the calculation resource allocation method with the average allocation and the on-demand allocation , experiments show that under the same time delay , the energy consumption of the computing resource allocation method was reduced by 99.36% compared with the average allocation , and the energy consumption was reduced by 85.24% compared with the average allocation.

articleTitle: AQI Prediction Model of Shijiazhuang City Based on Multivariate Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the rapid development of industrial industry, smoke, automobile exhaust and industrial exhaust emissions, various air pollution problems have become increasingly prominent. In order to prevent and control urban air pollution problems, it is necessary to understand the causes of air pollution and accurately grasp the changing trend of air quality (AQI). However, when traditional multiple linear regression and time series models predict AQI, there are some problems such as incomplete information utilization and low prediction accuracy. Based on this, the paper puts forward an AQI prediction method based on multiple time series (ARMAX). In the method, the lag order of AQI influencing factors in time series is introduced into the regression term, the residual series information is extracted, and the AQI prediction model is established. Taking Shijiazhuang city as an example, the data of AQI and its influencing factors from October 2013 to May 2022 in Shijiazhuang were collected. After preprocessing the data, the multiple linear regression model, the single time series model and the ARMAX model were used to fit and predict the data. After that, RMSE, MAE and MAPE are used to compare the prediction accuracy of the three models. The results show that the prediction accuracy of ARMAX model is significantly higher than that of single time series model or multiple linear regression model. Finally, according to the experimental conclusion, the article gives some suggestions for the prevention and control of air pollution in Shijiazhuang.

articleTitle: A Method for Building Chinese Domain Lexicon Based on New Words Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Professional domain lexicon construction is the basis for Domain-specific Natural Language Processing. Current new words detection algorithms struggle with migration and sparsity and are unable to facilitate the building of domain lexicons. In this paper, a method for building a domain-specific lexicon based on new words recommendation is proposed. A model of the domain lexicon construction process was developed, including domain corpus pre-processing, new words detection, saliency evaluation, and new words recommendation. The problem of the sparsity of unsupervised new words discovery algorithms is solved by using Enhanced Mutual Information and Branch Entropy to identify small word frequency words and NC-value to identify domain words. According to experiments on a guided domain dataset, the method is effective at enhancing the precision of domain new words recommendations, lowering the complexity of expert work, and has significant implications for the building of a domain-specific lexicon.

articleTitle: Optimization method for cloud service composition of machine tools under Multiple Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: To optimize the composition for a task collaborated by multiple machine tools in a cloud manufacturing (CMfg) environment, one method was proposed from the perspective of the demand side and with multiple constraints such as task scheduling, idle time window of machine tools and service quality (QoS) target taken into consideration. This method was to establish an evaluation system for optimization, which contained seven-dimensional objective components; to construct a multi-objective optimization model for composition under task timing constraints and limited idle time window constraints of machine tools in cloud service, and solve it with the improved ant colony optimization algorithm; finally to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method through an application example.

articleTitle: Design and Application of crop Variety Recommendation and Production Decision System in Agricultural Production
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Given the problems existing in the application of agricultural resources data, such as scattered datum resources, low degree of sharing, poor pertinence of technical guidance, low efficiency, and so on, this study designed a crop Variety Recommendation and Production Decision System based on GIS technology, multi-source database, and knowledge model, and preliminarily realized the sharing and visual analysis of meteorological environment, soil fertility and other agricultural resources data. The system adopts the REST framework to discover the front and back separation framework. Deep data mining builds expert knowledge rules for crop production technology management based on factors such as historical meteorological data, soil data, and crop variety suitability. They rely on spatial statistical analysis, time series data analysis, multi-source data fusion, and related crop knowledge model technology. It realizes application services such as various recommendations, post-disaster emergency guidance, production management decision-making, etc. The system was popularized and applied in Yuanyang County, Xinxiang City, in July 2021. According to the flood disaster on July 20 and the Internet weather forecast for seven days after the disaster, the system provides growers with replanted crops and varieties. Technical services are provided to reduce post-disaster economic losses and guide agricultural water-saving, fertilizer-saving, and other production applications.

articleTitle: PRAGCN: Personalized Recommendation Algorithm based on Graph Convolutional Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The recommendation system aims to provide users with personalized matching services, so as to effectively alleviate the problem of information overload in the era of big data, improve user experience, increase user stickiness, and greatly promote the development of e-commerce and other fields. However, in practical application scenarios, due to sparse data and cold start problems, it is often difficult for recommendation systems to obtain accurate recommendation results; The complex model design also leads to the unsatisfactory interpretability of the recommendation system. Therefore, how to make full use of interaction, attributes and various auxiliary information to improve the performance and interpretability of recommendation is the core problem of recommendation system. Most of the previous algorithms ignored the personality preferences in the comment data of users and products. To solve this problem, a method is proposed, which uses graph neural network to extract the association relationship, uses the advantage of graph deep learning to extract comments, extracts the preferences of users and goods, and carries out feature fusion to improve the recommendation effect. Comparative experiments were carried out in four groups of public data sets, and the effectiveness of the method was verified by ablation experiments. Experiments show that this method is better than the existing related algorithms, and can improve the recommendation effect.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Learning-Based HPC Multi-Resource Demand Prediction Model for Hybrid Clusters
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Growing workload demands and rapidly evolving HPC infrastructures drive the diversification of HPC cluster environments, and complex HPC applications are increasingly demanding for rational resource allocation. Based on the current development status, we propose a multivariate resource load forecasting model- MRDP (Multivariate Resource Demand Prediction)-based on the combination of deep learning and integrated learning, which can predict the overall job running time, CPU requirements and memory requirements of jobs in multiple HPC production environments. To provide the necessary prerequisites for making decisions on HPC job-aware scheduling schemes in hybrid clusters. We design experiments to evaluate this model against other models and multiple output regression algorithms in machine learning. The experimental results show that our MRDP model outperforms other models and algorithms in terms of prediction accuracy, model stability, and fitting effectiveness

articleTitle: Private Data Sharing in EMU Maintenance: A Method Study Based on Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In the maintenance of (Electric Multiple Unit) EMU, the operation of intelligent operation and maintenance model needs the support of data sharing from multiple subjects. However, in the context of strict safety supervision in the railway industry, the data security and privacy protection requirements of each subject have formed a huge challenge to data sharing. Therefore, this paper proposes a new method of EMU maintenance data sharing based on federated learning, which solves the problem that some data subjects cannot share data due to the private data. In this paper, a case analysis of the method is carried out to realize the multi-subject joint training of a decision tree prediction model under the premise of protecting the privacy data in the real maintenance scenarios.

articleTitle: Extrinsic Parameter Calibration and Dynamic Objects Coping Strategy for Multi-camera SLAM
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Perceiving the surrounding environment timely and accurately is very essential to improve the safety of mobile robots. To obtain rich information and increase the visual field of mobile robots, the development of multi-camera simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system has become a hot research field. In the current research, multi-camera extrinsic parameter calibration and multi-camera dynamic SLAM are still challenging. Therefore, this paper proposes a dynamic environment-oriented multi-camera SLAM system. This system not only presents an accurate multi-camera extrinsic parameter calibration method but also can achieve accurate localization in the environment with dynamic objects. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified through comprehensive experiments.

articleTitle: Action Recognition Based on Multidimensional Palm Action Features
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In the present study, a small sample palm motion detection method based on two hand motion features was established to overcome the problem of low accuracy of hand motion recognition. Firstly, the contour of hand motion was accurately extracted by the self-designed two-segment skin color extraction algorithm. A 5-layer convolutional neural network was then used to identify hand movements with high initial contour differentiation. Subsequently, for movements of which there are difficulties in directly distinguishing contours, skeleton data of the hand were extracted through OpenPose, and feature parameters were constructed to distinguish three hand movements with a high degree of contour confusion, namely, holding, opening and merging of five fingers. Finally, a simultaneous analysis algorithm was established to accurately identify the 10 kinds of hand movements. The overall recognition accuracy of the 10 kinds of hand movements reached over 96%, and the average recognition accuracy reached 98.4%.

articleTitle: Face Clustering Algorithm Based on Domain Structural Similarity
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: A KNN-Struct-ChineseWhispers algorithm based on K-nearest neighbour similarity aggregation is proposed for face clustering to address the problem that the ChineseWhispers algorithm is slow for large-scale face clustering and noisy edges lead to reduced clustering accuracy. Using Faiss to speed up the K-nearest neighbour graph initialisation process, the problem of calculating the similarity between two nodes is transformed into a limited radius K neighbour query for a single node corresponding to the indexed clustering centre. The noisy edges in the graph are filtered by aggregating feature similarity through the neighbourhood structure, and an isolated node detection module is added to improve computational efficiency and clustering accuracy. Based on the CNN+ArcFace Loss method for extracting face features, experiments on several benchmark datasets show that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the time efficiency and accuracy of clustering compared to existing face clustering algorithms.
